_comment: Questions for UFV Campus Dataset evaluation. Two experiments: Exp1 (navigation element recognition) and Exp2 (location state extraction). Prompts use constrained format for closed questions and free format for extraction tasks.

experiment1.name: Navigation Element Recognition
experiment1.description: Evaluates PaliGemma ability to recognize and classify navigation elements in indoor campus images.

questions.question: Is there a staircase visible in this image? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives. Negatives expected answer: no.

questions.question: Are the stairs going up or down as seen from the camera? Answer with one word: up or down.
Does the staircase have handrails? Answer yes or no.
What is the main navigation element visible in this image? Answer with one word.
questions.note: Keywords kept strict (2 terms) so BERTScore captures additional variants like stair, steps, flight.

questions.question: Is there an elevator visible in this image? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives.

questions.question: Are the elevator doors open or closed? Answer with one word: open or closed.
What is the main navigation element visible in this image? Answer with one word.
Is there a door visible in this image? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives.

questions.question: Is the door open or closed? Answer with one word: open or closed.
What is the main navigation element visible in this image? Answer with one word.
Is this a bathroom door? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives. Negatives expected answer: no.

questions.question: Is this an exit door? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives. Negatives expected answer: no.

questions.question: Is the door open or closed? Answer with one word: open or closed.
What navigation sign is visible on this door? Answer with one word.
questions.note: Per-image keyword overrides defined in expected_answers (bathroom vs exit). BERTScore reference also overridden per image.

questions.question: Is there an object blocking the walking path? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives. Critical safety metric.

questions.question: Is the path ahead clear to walk through? Answer yes or no.
questions.note: Applies to all images including negatives. Critical safety metric.

questions.question: What is the main object blocking the walking path? Answer with one word.
questions.note: Per-image keyword overrides defined in expected_answers. BERTScore reference overridden per image.

experiment2.name: Location State Extraction
experiment2.description: Evaluates PaliGemma ability to extract location information from building signs and room number signs. Free-format prompts used to allow BERTScore evaluation of flexible responses.

questions.question: What building code and floor number are shown in this sign? Answer with the building code followed by the floor number, separated by a space (for example: EPS 0, G 1, EPS 2). If only the floor number is visible, answer with only the number (for example: -1, 0, 1, 2). If no information is visible, answer none.
questions.note: Combined building+floor extraction. Parse response to extract building and floor separately. BERTScore only for type=complete images (bertscore_reference != null). location_accuracy only for type=complete.

questions.question: Is there a room code or number visible on this door or next to it? Answer yes or no.
What is the room code shown on or next to this door? Answer with only the room code (for example: 1.2, 0.4, or IA).
questions.note: Room Code Accuracy checks if expected code appears in model response. Free format to capture variants: 1.2, room 1.2, 1.2 is the room number.

questions.question: Is the door open or closed? Answer with one word: open or closed.

metadata.prompt_strategy: Constrained prompting for closed questions (yes/no, open/closed, up/down). Combined extraction for building_sign (building code + floor in one prompt). Free format for room code.
metadata.bertscore_usage: Exp1: applied to element questions (keyword strict + BERTScore flexible). Exp2: applied to building_sign combined response for type=complete images only (bertscore_reference = 'EPS 0', 'G 1', etc.). Not used for room_code (too short, exact match sufficient).
metadata.hazard_miss_rate_note: obstacle_detection: hazard_miss_rate = 1 - recall (missed obstacles). obstacle_safety (path clear, yes=clear): safety_hazard_miss_rate = FP/(FP+TN) among actually-unsafe cases (model says clear when it is not). Lower is better for both. Critical for visually impaired users.
